thread:
aj: Quick heads-up — planning to push feature/x (DB-prefetch + flag) to prod tonight at 22:00 UTC. Leaving this thread for rollback/readiness checks.

devon: Sounds good. Who's owning the canary window? I can sit on it 22:00–22:30 UTC.

samir: I can be on call for 22:30–23:15 if we need a follow-up rollback.

elaine: TL;DR of risks I flagged in PR: 1) short-lived DB index used during prefetch, 2) extra redis keys that might increase memory during warmup. Both have mitigation but want rollback plan clear.

aj: Good call. Rollback criteria we agreed:
- error rate > 1% sustained for 5m on /chat or /generate
- p95 latency > 2s for 10m
- memory pressure > 85% on redis cluster for 5m
If any trigger, we rollback to last-stable (commit: 33f4a7).

devon: Rollback runbook snippet (for quick paste):
```
# rollback to last-stable
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service inference --to 33f4a7 --strategy immediate
# verify smoke
curl -sS https://api.prod.redwood.ai/health | jq .status
```

elaine: Can we add a toggle in front of DB prefetch so we can disable without full rollback? Even if turned off, feature still serves without prefetch.

aj: Yes — feature flag `ff_db_prefetch` will be ON for canary (10% traffic) and we have an escape toggle in Console under Releases > feature/x. Ops knows the path.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: rollout feature/x canary 10% @ 22:00 UTC (canary duration 30m). Owner: devon.

oncall-ops: I verified infra hooks: auto-fallback to fallback-model on model OOM is enabled; alerting to #incidents and PagerDuty will trigger if error rate triggers. Make sure your runbook has the PD escalation step.

samir: PD escalation steps are in the runbook: page oncall-ml -> if no ack in 5m, notify eng-oncall -> if still unresolved 15m, exec rollback.

devon: Quick smoke checklist I'll run after canary starts:
- [ ] a few sample requests to /generate (short/long)
- [ ] check redis memory and key growth
- [ ] run a small perf script for 2m at peak qps
- [ ] validate responses for quality regressions (smoke prompts)

elaine: I'm adding two prompts to the smoke set (edge-case truncation) and one negative test for prefetch race. Will push to the runbook now.

aj: OK — go/no-go process: owners: devon + aj + elaine. After 30m canary we do quick sync here: 
- vote :thumbsup: to proceed ramp (to 50%) or :thumbsdown: rollback.
- if no votes within 10m after canary, default = hold at canary and escalate to oncall-ops.

devon: I'll post results and logs here at 22:31 UTC.

samir: I'll standby and be ready to run rollback command if needed.

aj: Thanks all — tagging PD oncall: @oncall-ops. Anything else?

elaine: One more: DB migration is non-blocking but we added a safety toggle `migrations_block` in infra. If we see schema issues we can flip it.

devon: Noted. All good from my side.

aj: Great — see you at 22:00. :rocket:
